basic_profile.bio: A passionate gamer and DIY enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I've been modding my Xbox Skyrim for years, exploring every digital nook and cranny. Outside the virtual world, I'm a chemist by profession, specializing in plant-based extractions. I've recently delved into the world of CBD and plant-derived concentrates. True crime podcasts are my jam, and I have a keen interest in understanding the psychology behind criminal behavior. I identify as a butch lesbian and am in a committed relationship. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, often with a cup of herbal tea in hand.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Chemistry and have worked extensively in the extraction industry, focusing on plant-based solutions. I've self-taught myself in the art of modding games, particularly for Xbox, and frequently engage with communities to share and gain insights. My interest in true crime stems from years of consuming diverse media and engaging in discussions that explore the intricacies of criminal psychology.
